# Planck.js 1.5.0

Unmodified official `dist/planck.js` from the npm package `planck@1.5.0`.
The readable UMD build is shared by the browser and the bundled server replay.
No testbed, CDN request, or runtime package installation is needed.

- Project: https://github.com/piqnt/planck.js
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/planck/-/planck-1.5.0.tgz
- Package archive SHA-256: `e67f906f6a1c93e0db686784e78365453d10c86d5621d33956bc53814e66acf5`
- License: [MIT](PLANCK-LICENSE.txt), also embedded in the source.

Update this file and regenerate the server replay bundle together when changing the engine version.
